significance.justification: A verified-true result would establish both a form-(iii) predictive coupling—“student transmission strength correlates with the magnitude of this statistical signature beyond what divergence-token frequency alone explains”—and a form-(ii) causal data-side account in which “Distribution-Matching Resampling…erases the signature and causally suppresses transmission.” This would fix expectations beyond the observed datasets: larger signatures should predict stronger transmission, while targeted distribution matching should suppress it more than equally large untargeted changes; thus it establishes a weighty phenomenon and a causal carrier account, though not a full model-internal mechanism. Cloud et al.'s Subliminal Learning identifies transmission through filtered number data and a matched-base dependence, so distinguishing aggregate distributional carriage from sparse token-level carriage bears directly on the unresolved explanation; a negative result would instead constrain aggregate-statistics accounts, although failure of the finite feature battery would not rule out every such account. True and false outcomes are distinguishable despite the compound hypothesis, and the topic-substitution check passes: replacing these specific predictive and causal relations with merely “extend subliminal learning” would not merit this score.

reach.justification: The principal handle is the explicitly named “trait-agnostic Distribution-Matching Resampling defense,” accompanied by a “lightweight statistical classifier” and a measurable signature magnitude; the defense is ex ante because it operates “at the data-ingestion stage” before student training or transmission. Its downstream consumer is a distillation practitioner who “receives only synthetic data and has no access to the teacher model,” so it could support screening or gating rather than merely post-hoc interpretation. After recalibration on another teacher or model, the predictive correlation between signature magnitude and transmission would still state what should be found, but the concrete feature signature may be “trait- and model-family specific,” and the core hypothesis is framed most firmly around number sequences, limiting broad transfer. The topic-substitution check passes: generic subliminal-learning research supplies neither this model-free ingestion defense nor its advance-warning window.
